results.name: Concurrent Burst Race Competing for Limited Cash Pool

results.expected: Subset executes, remainder rejected with Insufficient Funds, final cash >= 0

results.name: Mass Simultaneous Client Reconnect During Active Price Updates

results.expected: 20/20 reconnected cleanly, 0 dropped, 20/20 received immediate STATE_UPDATE
results.actual: Reconnected: 20/20, Catch-up Delivered: 20/20, Errors: 0

results.name: Order Workflow Stages and State Preservation Across Server Restart

results.name: Multi-Currency Wallet and Reserved Cash Preservation Across Server Restart

results.name: Bank Settlement Vouchers and Status Preservation Across Server Restart

results.name: In-Flight Mutex Memory Lock Recovery and Progression Post-Restart
